statusSummary: This demo snapshot is blocked by four source-backed integration/build issues. It is not a production-readiness assessment.

categories.name: Build
categories.summary: The ShopSphere Vite build fails because its project root has no index.html entry file.

categories.name: Tests
categories.summary: All three ShopSphere backend unit tests passed local validation on 2026-09-26; refreshing this report does not rerun them.

categories.name: Security
categories.summary: Root and Spring Web log levels are DEBUG. Source does not evidence request-body or credential logging.

categories.name: Dependencies
categories.summary: This snapshot does not check dependency currency or scan for vulnerabilities.

categories.name: Configuration
categories.summary: The frontend targets the wrong backend port, requests an unimplemented products endpoint, and the datasource has no declared JDBC driver.

categories.name: Documentation
categories.summary: ShopSphere is a demo fixture, not a deployable production application; deployment readiness is not evaluated.
